# Demo Review Checklist: End-to-End Demo on the Board

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the change kind, the driver on the board, the new
moments and the rehearsal, for the reviewer at Gate 2 (plan review)
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Change kind

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the change item's lifecycle complete (awaiting, approved, rejected; what happens to the item when the run is terminated or the change is superseded)? [Coverage, Spec §US2, research R-02]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is it specified which change records get an item (every change of a run, or only those awaiting a decision when first projected)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the refusal of a run decision on a change item (and the reverse) specified with its reason code and comment? [Completeness, contracts/board-and-demo.md]

## Driver

- [ ] CHK004 - Is SC-002 ("every human step is a board change by the named person") measurable from data the platform keeps (run activity `source`, the simulator's history)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the driver's wait for a projected item bounded, and is the failure message defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the behaviour defined when the presenter acts on the wrong item or with a wrong value (the step fails; how to resume)? [Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]

## New moments

- [ ] CHK007 - Are the D-12 and D-13 steps placed so they do not change the main journey's runs or the recorded replies' call order? [Consistency, research R-07, R-08]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "drift" defined precisely (a platform-written field changed by the service account, which the sync reads as its own), and is it clear this is a demo device, not a supported operation? [Clarity, Spec §US4]

## Rehearsal and secrets

- [ ] CHK009 - Are the token rules stated (length, where the file lives, permissions, never printed or committed) for the people's tokens and the sync's? [Completeness, research R-06]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is `token import` recorded as a simulator-only difference from ADO, and limited so it cannot replace an existing token? [Traceability, contracts/board-and-demo.md]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the fallback to the inbox during a demo (019) part of the guide with its steps and its cost (an API restart)? [Coverage, Spec §US5-3]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
